run_dinov2_training: run the DINOv2 training job using submitit with a config file and training arguments
submit_training_jobs: submit DINOv2 training jobs to a cluster using the Trainer class and submit_jobs function
setup_trainer_checkpoint: create a Trainer instance that supports checkpointing and requeuing via submitit DelayedSubmission
configure_training_args: parse and configure training arguments using the combined train and submit argument parsers
setup_job_environment: setup the submitit job environment with job ID replacement and process group logging
